[ITST.5.2.2] Why per-scenario functions instead of one
monolithic main():
- **Failure isolation.** A failure in scenario A
  doesn't mask scenario B.
- **Naming as documentation.** The function name cites
  what's tested ([ITST.5.3]).
- **Easy to add / remove.** New scenario = new function
  + new line in main(). No threading through giant
  control flow.
